rationale: The editor data plane (host parameter surfaces, value sources, value channels, AudioBridge and VisualizationBridge) moves out of core/view into the UI-free Pulp module core/dataplane. Under core/view only build wiring, forward declarations and forwarding headers change: the pulp/view headers include their pulp/dataplane counterparts and re-export the names into pulp::view, view-core and view-audio link the new targets, and the sources leave PulpViewSources.cmake. design_param_binding.hpp only drops a forward declaration of HostParamSurface. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, asset or packaging behaviour changes and no authority moves; Vellum does not inherit the move.
